title: TOEIC Listening Part 1 — AI-generated Photo Practice Reserve
purpose: Add three distinct Part 1 practice photo resources to expand the review queue. These are not independently reviewed and are excluded from Mock.
sourcePolicy: Project-generated with Google Imagen in Google AI Studio. Not Pexels photography. No human photographer is claimed.
reservePolicy: All resources and questions remain reserve-pending-independent-review with question-level mockEligible=false. Do not map to learning-outcome criteria or promote until an independent reviewer verifies the photograph, each spoken statement, the unique answer and distractors.

listening.correctEvidence: A site engineer is reviewing a set of building plans.
A laboratory technician is looking through a microscope.
A store employee is checking a canned product on a supermarket shelf.
